extracted.intended_audience: Users of GAP (computational algebraists, mathematicians, and developers using GAP matrix routines)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for GAP functions and attributes that operate on matrices (normal forms, echelonization, nullspaces, canonical forms, finite-field representations, block matrices, integer-lattice procedures, and related transforms).

rubrics_metrics.name: ElementaryDivisorsMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute the elementary divisors of a matrix: returns a unique list d with d[i] dividing d[i+1]; operations are performed over an Euclidean ring which must contain all matrix entries (ring argument optional, defaults to DefaultRing of entries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produces invariant factors / diagonal form equivalent to a diagonal matrix with elements d[i]. Examples show operation on integer and polynomial matrices. Note: a destructive variant exists that may overwrite the input matrix.

rubrics_metrics.name: ElementaryDivisorsMatDestructive
rubrics_metrics.description: Destructive variant of ElementaryDivisorsMat which produces the same result but may destroy the contents of mat.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when memory savings or in-place behavior is desired; be aware mat will be modified.

rubrics_metrics.name: ElementaryDivisorsTransformationsMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Like ElementaryDivisorsMat but additionally computes transforming matrices; returns a record with normal (S), rowtrans (P), coltrans (Q) such that P * A * Q = S. Operates over an Euclidean ring; ring argument optional (defaults to DefaultRing).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The output record includes transforming matrices useful to verify PAQ = S; examples show polynomial matrices and explicit row/col transform matrices. A destructive variant exists.

rubrics_metrics.name: ElementaryDivisorsTransformationsMatDestructive
rubrics_metrics.description: Destructive variant of ElementaryDivisorsTransformationsMat; returns same record but may destroy mat.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use with caution if original matrix must be retained.

rubrics_metrics.name: DiagonalizeMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Bring a mutable matrix mat (over ring) into diagonal form by elementary row and column operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operates in-place on mutable matrices; example shows integer matrix diagonalized to [1,0;0,3].

rubrics_metrics.name: SemiEchelonMat
rubrics_metrics.description: For a matrix over a field F, returns a record describing a semi-echelon form: list of row vectors (vectors) with pivot element 1 and heads giving pivot column locations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Semi-echelon: first nonzero of each row is identity of F and entries below pivots are zero. The record contains vectors and heads.

rubrics_metrics.name: SemiEchelonMatDestructive
rubrics_metrics.description: Destructive version of SemiEchelonMat; computes the same record but may (and probably will) destroy the matrix mat.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows input matrix mutated to semi-echelon rows with a zero row at the bottom.

rubrics_metrics.name: SemiEchelonMatTransformation
rubrics_metrics.description: Same as SemiEchelonMat but additionally stores the linear transformation T performed on the matrix; returns coeffs (coefficients of vectors relative to original rows) and relations (basis of left nullspace).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record includes coeffs, heads, relations, vectors. Useful for reconstructing the transformation and nullspace info.

rubrics_metrics.name: SemiEchelonMats
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a list of matrices, returns a record describing a semi-echelonized form of the concatenated row vectors: vectors (list of matrices with pivot element 1) and heads (matrix indicating which input matrix supplies each pivot).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines semi-echelon property for a list of matrices via concatenation of their rows. Useful for block or multi-matrix row-space operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: SemiEchelonMatsDestructive
rubrics_metrics.description: Destructive version of SemiEchelonMats; may destroy its argument list of mutable matrices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use only when mutating inputs is acceptable; argument must be mutable matrices.

rubrics_metrics.name: BaseMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a basis for the row space generated by the rows of mat as an immutable matrix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns an immutable matrix representing a basis in row-echelon-like form; example provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: BaseMatDestructive
rubrics_metrics.description: Destructive variant of BaseMat: may destroy mat and returns a basis for the row space as a matrix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Input must be mutable; example shows mutated matrix with zero row after destruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: BaseOrthogonalSpaceMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes a basis of the orthogonal space of the row space generated by mat (over any field containing entries of mat).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rows of mat need not be independent; returns basis for orthogonal complement.

rubrics_metrics.name: SumIntersectionMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Performs Zassenhaus' algorithm to compute bases for the sum and intersection of row-spaces generated by M1 and M2; returns [base_of_sum, base_of_intersection], both in semi-echelon form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for computing subspace join and meet; example demonstrates outputs for given inputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: BaseSteinitzVectors
rubrics_metrics.description: Given bas and mat (full row rank matrices), finds vectors extending mat to a basis spanning span(bas); returns record with subspace (upper triangular basis of span(mat)), factorspace (extending vectors), factorzero (zero vector), and heads (decomposition indices indicating echelon steps).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both bas and mat must have full row rank. Example demonstrates returned record structure and values.

rubrics_metrics.name: DiagonalOfMatrix / DiagonalOfMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Return the diagonal of matrix mat; if mat not square, result length equals number of rows and padded with zeros if fewer rows than columns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple accessor; example shows behavior on non-square matrices.

rubrics_metrics.name: UpperSubdiagonal
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a mutable list containing the entries of the pos-th upper subdiagonal of matrix mat.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: pos is index of which upper subdiagonal to extract (pos=1 gives first upper diagonal above main diagonal). Examples show various matrix shapes.

rubrics_metrics.name: DepthOfUpperTriangularMatrix
rubrics_metrics.description: If mat is upper triangular, returns the index of the first nonzero diagonal (i.e., depth).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example demonstrates two matrices with different depths (1 vs 2).

rubrics_metrics.name: CharacteristicPolynomial
rubrics_metrics.description: For square mat, returns the characteristic polynomial (StandardAssociate of det(mat - X*I)). Optionally takes fields F and E to compute characteristic polynomial of F-linear mapping induced by mat on underlying E-vector space, using BlownUpMat when needed; ind (indeterminate number) optional (defaults to 1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CharacteristicPolynomial(F,E,mat) may return a multiple of MinimalPolynomial(F,mat). Note historical compatibility caveat: older versions allowed ambiguous single-field argument. Examples show integer, cyclotomic, and field-extension uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: RationalCanonicalFormTransform
rubrics_metrics.description: Return a matrix P such that A^P (or AP depending on convention) is in rational canonical (Frobenius) normal form. Algorithm is standard textbook version (not optimal complexity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to obtain Frobenius normal form; example shows applying transform yields canonical block structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: JordanDecomposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns [S,N] such that S is semisimple, N nilpotent, S and N commute, and mat = S + N.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives additive Jordan decomposition; example with matrix returning original as semisimple and zero nilpotent part.

rubrics_metrics.name: BlownUpMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Given basis B of field extension F/K and mat with entries in F, returns a matrix over K obtained by replacing each entry of mat by its regular representation w.r.t. B (i.e., expands linear transformation on F^n to K^{m n}).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interprets rows as concatenations of B-coefficients; compatible with BlownUpVector. Not checked whether entries are indeed in F (caller responsibility).

rubrics_metrics.name: BlownUpVector
rubrics_metrics.description: Given basis B of F/K and a row vector with entries in F, returns a row vector over K obtained by replacing each entry by its coefficients w.r.t. B.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compatible with BlownUpMat: BlownUpVector(B, mat * vector) equals BlownUpMat(B, mat) * BlownUpVector(B, vector). Example shows equality check.

rubrics_metrics.name: CompanionMatrix / CompanionMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Return the companion matrix of polynomial poly (fully mutable); negatives of coefficients of poly appear in last column. Companion matrix has poly as minimal and characteristic polynomial.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example constructs companion matrix and verifies MinimalPolynomial(M) == poly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compressed Matrix Representations (finite fields)
rubrics_metrics.description: GAP uses special compact representations for matrices over small finite fields: eligibility requires each row be representable as a compact row vector of same length over same finite field; representation choices depend on field size and matrix size (GF(2) all compressed; GF(q) for 3<=q<=256 compressed when matrix has 25+ entries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advantages: memory/time improvements for low dimensions; caveats: list access/assignment may be slower; vectors in compressed matrices cannot change length/field; filter IsLockedRepresentationVector enforced; mixing rows of different compressed fields fails. Examples show ConvertToVectorRep/ConvertToMatrixRep usage and failure modes.

rubrics_metrics.name: ImmutableMatrix
rubrics_metrics.description: Return an immutable matrix object (optimal representation) equal to given matrix for specified field; if 'change' true, may change matrix or its rows to become immutable, else rows are copied.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If input is IsMatrix, rows/representation might change as side effect but not guaranteed; if matrix already immutable and representation equal, result not necessarily identical. Ensures compatibility for fast arithmetic across multiple ImmutableMatrix calls with same field.

rubrics_metrics.name: ConvertToMatrixRep (and NC variants)
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical function to convert a list of rows to internal compressed matrix representation for a given field or fieldsize; NC versions do less checking and may crash on unsuitable arguments. Forbidden unless all elements are row vectors with entries in the field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May fail on locked vectors or inconsistent representations; returns size of field if conversion succeeds. Use ImmutableMatrix for safer, higher-level behavior; ConvertToMatrixRep can avoid copying but is more fragile. Examples illustrate locked-vector failure and workaround via ShallowCopy.

rubrics_metrics.name: ProjectiveOrder
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns integer n and finite field element e such that A^n = e * I for a matrix mat over a finite field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for projective order computations; example returns [5, Z(11)^5].

rubrics_metrics.name: SimultaneousEigenvalues
rubrics_metrics.description: For matlist of matrices over GF(q) that generate an abelian p-group of exponent expo, returns matrix of integers mod expo (a_{i,j}) such that eigenvalues in a splitting field are powers ξ^{a_{i,j}}; eigenspaces across matrices to eigenvalues ξ^{a_{i,j}} for fixed j are equal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preconditions: matrices over same GF(q) and generate an abelian p-group of given exponent. Useful in simultaneous diagonalization/eigenspace comparison.

rubrics_metrics.name: InverseMatMod
rubrics_metrics.description: For square integer matrix mat and modulus obj, returns inv such that inv * mat ≡ identity (mod obj) if such inverse exists, else fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used for computing modular inverses of matrices; example shows multiplication results with modular residues but note returns inv so inv*mat congruent to I modulo obj.

rubrics_metrics.name: BasisNullspaceModN
rubrics_metrics.description: Given integer matrix M and positive integer n, returns a set B of vectors such that every vector v (mod n) satisfying v * M ≡ 0 (mod n) can be expressed as a Z-linear combination of elements of B.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produces generating set (over Z) for nullspace modulo n; intended for integer-matrix modular nullspace computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: NullspaceModQ / NullspaceModN
rubrics_metrics.description: Given integer matrix M and modulus n (or q), returns set of all vectors modulo n that solve v * M ≡ 0 (mod n). NullspaceModQ is a synonym for NullspaceModN.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show small-modulus behaviors and enumerated solution sets; useful for modular linear algebra solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PROD_GF2MAT_GF2MAT_SIMPLE
rubrics_metrics.description: Performs standard unblocked and ungreased matrix multiplication for matrices of any size (baseline multiplication over GF(2)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple fallback multiplication; used when special greasing/blocking not desired.

rubrics_metrics.name: PROD_GF2MAT_GF2MAT_ADVANCED
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes product of two compressed GF(2) matrices using level g grease and level b blocking; both matrices must be compressed GF(2) matrices of compatible dimensions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implements greased blocked multiplication (level-8 grease default for large dims) with experimental tuning; parameters g (grease) and b (blocking) permit exact control over tradeoffs. Useful for very large GF(2) multiplications (>=128 dims recommended).

rubrics_metrics.name: AsBlockMatrix
rubrics_metrics.description: Return a block matrix with nrb row blocks and ncb column blocks equal to ordinary matrix m.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Converts ordinary matrix to block-matrix representation; useful when block structure present for memory savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: BlockMatrix
rubrics_metrics.description: Return an immutable matrix in sparse block representation IsBlockMatrixRep constructed from list of triples [i, j, M(i,j)] where all nonzero blocks have same dimensions; requires ordinary matrices for blocks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If blocks list empty, rpb and cpb must supply block dimensions and zero value. Resulting matrix is an ordinary matrix and supports Display. Example constructs and displays block matrix.

rubrics_metrics.name: MatrixByBlockMatrix
rubrics_metrics.description: Return a plain ordinary matrix equal to the block matrix blockmat (materialize block representation into standard matrix).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute to convert block representation back to ordinary matrix for operations that expect ordinary matrices.

rubrics_metrics.name: SimplexMethod
rubrics_metrics.description: Find a rational vector x that maximizes x · c subject to constraints A · x ≤ b (linear programming via simplex).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inputs A, b, c are rational; returns solution vector and objective value. Example demonstrates solving a small LP.

rubrics_metrics.name: NullspaceIntMat
rubrics_metrics.description: For integer matrix mat, return list of vectors forming a basis of the integral nullspace (vectors in nullspace with integer entries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes from rational nullspace by returning integer-basis solutions; example contrasts NullspaceMat vs NullspaceIntMat outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: SolutionIntMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Given integer matrix mat and integer vector vec, return integer vector x solving x * mat = vec if one exists, else fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns integer solution when possible; example shows rational solution from SolutionMat and integer solution from SolutionIntMat.

rubrics_metrics.name: SolutionNullspaceIntMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a list of length two: first entry is result of SolutionIntMat(mat, vec), second entry is NullspaceIntMat(mat); computed faster than separate calls.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Convenience combined operation to get integer solution and integer nullspace in one call; example demonstrates returned pair.

rubrics_metrics.name: BaseIntMat
rubrics_metrics.description: For integer matrix mat, return a list of vectors that forms a basis of the integral row space of mat (integral linear combinations of rows).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example returns upper-triangular-like integer basis; used in lattice and integer-row-space computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: BaseIntersectionIntMats
rubrics_metrics.description: For integer matrices m and n, return a list of vectors forming a basis of the intersection of their integral row spaces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows returned integer basis for intersection; useful for lattice intersection problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: ComplementIntMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Given full (list of integer vectors generating integral row module M) and sub (vectors generating submodule S), compute a free basis for M that extends S and integers xi such that si := xi * bi form a basis for S. Returns record with complement (bn+1..bm), sub (si), and moduli (xi).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides decomposed basis and moduli showing how submodule sits inside full module. Example given.

rubrics_metrics.name: TriangulizedIntegerMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute an upper triangular form of an integer matrix; returns a mutable matrix in upper triangular form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of integer normal-form toolkit; example shows triangularized matrix.

rubrics_metrics.name: TriangulizedIntegerMatTransform
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute upper triangular form of integer matrix and return record with normal (immutable triangular matrix) and rowtrans giving transformations so that rowtrans * original = normal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record includes rank, rowC, rowQ, rowtrans, signdet in example; useful to recover transformation matrices.

rubrics_metrics.name: TriangulizeIntegerMat
rubrics_metrics.description: In-place change of mat to be in upper triangular form (mutable); equivalent to TriangulizedIntegerMat but mutates input and uses less memory; triggers error if mat is immutable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when in-place modification acceptable; example demonstrates mutated mat.

rubrics_metrics.name: HermiteNormalFormIntegerMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute Hermite Normal Form (HNF) of integer matrix mat; returns an immutable matrix in HNF.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HNF is row-equivalent upper triangular with off-diagonal entries reduced modulo diagonal of their column; unique HNF and unimodular Q exists with Q*A = H. Example provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: HermiteNormalFormIntegerMatTransform
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute HNF and return record with components normal (H) and rowtrans (Q) such that Q * A = H, plus rank and other metadata.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful when transformation matrix is needed; example shows rowtrans*mat == normal.

rubrics_metrics.name: SmithNormalFormIntegerMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute Smith Normal Form (SNF) of an integer matrix; returns a new immutable matrix in Smith normal form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SNF is unique diagonal form with divisibility Si | Sj for i<j; unimodular P,Q exist with P*A*Q = S.

rubrics_metrics.name: SmithNormalFormIntegerMatTransforms
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute Smith Normal Form and return record with normal (S), rowtrans (P), coltrans (Q) such that P * A * Q = S.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides full transformation matrices for SNF; example demonstrates verification n.rowtrans * m * n.coltrans = n.normal.

rubrics_metrics.name: DiagonalizeIntMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Destructive function equivalent to SmithNormalFormIntegerMat but modifies mat in-place to its SNF; error if mat immutable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when in-place modification desired to save memory; example shows mutated mat becomes SNF diagonal.

rubrics_metrics.name: NormalFormIntMat
rubrics_metrics.description: General operation computing various normal forms of integer matrices. Signature NormalFormIntMat(mat, options) where options bit values select form and transforms: 0/1 Triangular Form / Smith Normal Form; bits for Reduce off-diagonal entries, Row Transformations, Col Transformations, Destructive. Returns record with normal form and optional rowtrans/coltrans, signdet, rank.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Options are bitmask from 0 to 15; nonsensical combinations ignored. Example calls demonstrate triangular (0), Hermite with row transforms (6), and Smith with both transforms (13). Useful as efficient 'workhorse' for integer normal forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: AbelianInvariantsOfList
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a list of nonnegative integers, return a sorted list containing the prime-power factors of the positive entries and all zeroes from the original list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to compute invariants for finite abelian groups from list of invariant factors; example demonstrates factoring and sorting into prime powers and zeros.
